title: Key Equations — Mechanics Foundations (Kinematics + Dynamics)
notes: - **Kinematics:** v = u + at; s = ut + ½at²; v² = u² + 2as; v = dx/dt; a = dv/dt
- **Free fall:** v = gt; h = ½gt²; v² = 2gh
- **Projectile:** T = 2u sinθ/g; H = u² sin²θ/(2g); R = u² sin2θ/g (max u²/g at 45°)
- **Friction:** f_s = μ_sN; f_k = μ_kN; tanθ_repose = μ
- **Torque:** τ = F·d; equilibrium: ΣF = 0 and Στ = 0
